native_change: EMP_S036_CADICAL_OPTIONS (fail-closed name=value CaDiCaL options) and EMP_S036_STOP_FILE (cooperative UNKNOWN exit 0); search/propagation/certificate logic unchanged from the S035 resident native

common_settings.congruence: disabled via EMP_S035_DISABLE_CONGRUENCE (measured harmful in S035)

region_reason: Cold regions have semantic recovery only; the four retained RAM contexts 0,7,127,255 keep their original executable and settings and are never restarted for a comparison.
equal_input: Per region one immutable input.inst (base + S032 seed + all S035 ledger-accepted independently audited geometric cuts + region assumptions) is materialised once and hashed; every arm of that region reads the identical bytes.
measurement_window: From the first native progress line after lemma loading to exit; rates divide counter deltas by measured process CPU seconds in the same window.

arms.name: phase0
arms.meaning: initial decision phase false (layers start empty)

arms.name: focused
arms.meaning: focused mode only (VMTF, frequent restarts; CaDiCaL unsat-style)

arms.name: stable
arms.meaning: stable mode only (EVSIDS, target phases; CaDiCaL sat-style)

metrics: flat_counter_pathology (conflicts unchanged >=60 s with CPU busy)
adoption_rule: An arm replaces baseline for that region's later cold-slot spans only if it exited by timeout with no pathology, peak private <=1.5 GiB, conflicts/CPU-s >=1.5x baseline and geometric cuts/CPU-s >=0.75x baseline. Otherwise baseline is kept. Ties keep baseline.
interpretation_limits: Throughput and activity screens only. Counters are not progress toward closure, not an ETA and not evidence of SAT or UNSAT. Native UNSAT never closes a region without fresh standalone DRAT and an independent checker; any SAT/exit-10 outranks everything and is independently validated.
sharing_rule: Only independently subdivision-audited geometric clauses may enter a later cold recipe; private CDCL clauses never cross regions.
